verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for an infrastructure-as-code tool, since comparable IaC platforms issue scoped tokens. The evidence pack documents no OpenTofu mechanism for issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials to an agent, and the probes found no OpenAPI or API surface. The ability to 'manage team access in code' comes from providers acting on other platforms, so it is adjacent provider functionality and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
